title: Rank area concepts into the manifest under a history anchor
action: In build_context_manifest (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/knowledge/context.rs, after step (3) required_context and before step (4) the critical patterns), add one step for the non-work-item arms (Anchor::History, Anchor::Ledger, Anchor::Backlog): collect every concept whose type is bee.area, score them with score_critical_relevance against the same query_meta/query_body the critical step builds, and select the top AREA_KEEP = 3 whose score is > 0.0, ordered by score desc then path asc, with reason 'area concept (relevance <score>, rank <n> of <m>)' using jsjson::js_f64_to_string for the score exactly as the critical reason does. Skip a concept already in `selected`. The work-item arm (work_concept.is_some()) runs no area step and its manifest stays byte-identical. The zero_signal count and the critical conservation (entries + truncated + excluded == every critical) are untouched. Red first: in knowledge/tests.rs add a test next to history_anchor_resolves_from_whichever_of_context_and_plan_exist that puts one bee.area concept (with bee.anchors naming a real file under the temp root, via the Cx builder or a raw frontmatter put) whose title/body matches the CONTEXT.md text, one unrelated bee.area concept, and one critical pattern; assert the matching area is entry[1] with a reason starting 'area concept', the unrelated area is absent, and the critical pattern comes after the area. Add a second assertion (or test) that the work-item arm's entry list is unchanged by the presence of bee.area concepts. Watch the new test fail before the fix. Then run the existing knowledge tests. Knowledge delta in the same commit: in docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/context-and-promote.md extend the B6 paragraph that fixes the manifest order ('the work item, its bee.plan sibling, required_context in BFS depth order, critical patterns, then area decisions') to name the area step under the history/ledger/backlog arms and cite decision cdc5cf02; keep bee.anchors naming context.rs. One commit, no code comments.

truths: Under a history anchor whose CONTEXT.md text matches a bee.area concept, build_context_manifest selects that area concept with a reason starting 'area concept' ahead of every critical pattern entry
A bee.area concept scoring 0.0 against the anchor is never selected
A work-item anchor's manifest entries are unchanged by the presence of bee.area concepts
The new test was red before the fix and is green after it

artifacts.substantive: an AREA_KEEP constant and an area-ranking step between the required_context step and the critical-pattern step, gated on the non-work-item arms
a test asserting area selection under a history anchor and the unchanged work-item arm
the B6 manifest order names the area step under the fallback arms and cites cdc5cf02
